description: Symbolic MIDI notes only. No recordings, samples or lyrics.

songs.title: Amazing Grace
songs.attribution: Trad. / Arr.: Breizh Partitions, typeset by Breizh Partitions (2012), via Mutopia Project, piece 1832.
songs.changes: Removed short bagpipe grace notes; extended each main note to the next onset; transposed down 8 semitones to G; tempo 90; added suggested G/C/D chord markers. This adapted MIDI and its note data retain CC BY-SA 3.0. App code is separate.

songs.title: きらきら星
songs.composer: Traditional French melody (Ah! vous dirai-je, maman)
songs.attribution: Traditional melody, newly entered as a simple 42-note exercise by Music Stack. The linked public-domain edition is a reference, not the imported arrangement.
songs.changes: New symbolic transcription of the traditional melody in C, tempo 90, for sanshin honchoshi and guitar. Added suggested C/Fmaj7/G7 chord markers. No lyrics.

songs.title: 歓喜の歌（主題）
songs.attribution: Beethoven's public-domain theme, newly entered as a 30-note beginner exercise by Music Stack. The linked Mutopia public-domain SATB edition is a reference; its arrangement was not imported.
songs.changes: New symbolic transcription of the opening theme in C, tempo 90, with suggested C/G7 chord markers. No lyrics or recordings.

songs.title: てぃんさぐぬ花（1節・やさしい版）
songs.attribution: Kunkunshi for Tinsagu nu Hana, Lrschneider (2017), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Adaptation by Music Stack.
songs.changes: First verse with surrounding instrumental phrase. Transcribed the large symbols right-to-left, top-to-bottom; omitted small ornamental notes, set each cell to one beat at 85 BPM in C-F-C honchoshi. Retains the one-cell rest. 63 notes across 64 beats. This adapted MIDI and the note data in build-practice-sanshin.mjs retain CC BY-SA 4.0; application code is separate. No lyrics or source image are bundled.
